comments.author: DandyLionElmo
comments.body_html: my guy please I need to clear things up with the trigger, mask and chain event on the wiki. I dont understand them at all. Could you explain it to me here?

comments.author: Jejukon
comments.body_html:
Trigger - They are how you trigger the sound to play for example:

  • OnAgony - On usually means it auto triggers in that situation so on taking damage OnAgony will play.
  • GetToCover - This is a key press from the expressions menu.

Mask - I what situations do you want the voice line to work

Chain Event - This on is a bit confusing to tell if it work. I think its meant to chain together the voice lines, but I haven’t really noticed it working.
